description: Generate a daily AI news digest newsletter from fresh web sources. Use this skill whenever a user asks for AI news, wants a roundup or summary of recent AI/ML developments, asks what happened in artificial intelligence today or this week, requests a newsletter, briefing, or digest of model releases, research papers, funding rounds, product launches, regulation, or benchmark results — even if they don't explicitly say "newsletter." Also use for follow-up requests like "more AI news" or "catch me up on AI."
